'''''Sparganium erectum''''', the '''simplestem bur-reed'''<ref>{{PLANTS|id=SPER|taxon=Sparganium erectum|accessdate=24 November 2015}}</ref> or '''branched bur-reed''', is a perennial plant species in the genus ''[[Sparganium]]''.

The larvae of the moth ''[[Plusia festucae]]'' feed on ''Sparganium erectum''.
[[File:Sparganium erectum(Fruit).JPG|thumb|left|Fruits]]
